classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Armored front-liner who holds enemies' attention and soaks up their blows.

kit.name: Taunt
kit.description: Forces the enemy to turn on you. On an enemy within 20 m.

kit.name: Bash
kit.description: Stuns for 1.5 s, interrupts a cast. On an enemy within 2.5 m.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Healer who mends wounds and wards allies, with a hallowed blow of their own.

kit.name: Minor Heal
kit.description: Heals 15-20. On an ally within 25 m.

kit.name: Smite
kit.description: Deals 10-14 holy damage. On an enemy within 25 m.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Quick melee striker: sneaks, backstabs, bleeds enemies and slips out of fights.

kit.name: Backstab
kit.description: Deals 12-18 physical damage. On an enemy within 2.5 m.

kit.name: Sneak
kit.description: Hides you until you act. On yourself.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Fragile caster with the strongest spells, from bolts of fire and frost to roots.

kit.name: Flame Dart
kit.description: Deals 8-12 fire damage. On an enemy within 25 m.

kit.name: Frost Bolt
kit.description: Deals 10-14 cold damage, slows by 40% for 12 s. On an enemy within 25 m.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Armored hybrid who fights at the front and can heal, cleanse and judge.

kit.name: Hallowed Blow
kit.description: Deals 8-12 holy damage, heals you for 50% of the damage you deal. On an enemy within 2.5 m.

kit.name: Challenge
kit.description: Forces the enemy to turn on you. On an enemy within 20 m.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Nature caster who heals over time, entangles and slows enemies, and poisons them.

kit.name: Thorn Bolt
kit.description: Deals 8-12 nature damage. On an enemy within 25 m.

kit.name: Mend
kit.description: Heals 14-18. On an ally within 25 m.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Forces an enemy to turn on you, even from across the room. Use it to pull a mob off a friend who is taking the beating.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: A shield-first blow that stuns the enemy briefly and breaks off any spell it is casting. Use it when a caster starts to cast.
